displayName: OCI-DB-SQLITE-001: SQLite — Direct File Access from Web
description:
Detects direct SQLite database file access from web applications

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: sqlite — direct file access from web

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_sqlite_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%sqlite%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%direct%') AND "value" > 0
